summary: Added three ECS rules, E3052 (FargateNetworkMode: Fargate task definitions need NetworkMode awsvpc), E3053 (FargateExecutionRole: Fargate task definitions need ExecutionRoleArn), and E3054 (FargateNetworkConfiguration: Fargate ECS services need NetworkConfiguration). Each has a JSON schema extension, unit tests, and a docs/rules.md row. The ECS and rules-collection tests pass (99). The full unit suite has one failure, test_build_graph, which needs pygraphviz/pydot that the venv lacks. The formatter tests could not be collected because defusedxml is missing from the venv. Four integration tests fail; they shell out to an installed cfn-lint rather than the repo source, and a quickstart scan showed no E3052-E3054 hits, but I did not confirm them on a clean baseline. Nothing is committed. The rule choices were mine since the spec does not name them; please confirm they match what you wanted.
